description: Manages user accounts, roles, and organizational unit settings within the system, including bulk operations and access control.

endpoints.name: GetUsers
endpoints.description: Get paginated list of users with filtering and search capabilities. This endpoint supports advanced search criteria. To use advanced search, provide a 'request' body with parameters like 'SearchTerm', 'RoleFilter', 'OrgUnitFilter', 'ShowMyOrgUnitOnly', 'PageIndex', and 'PageSize'. You can also specify 'SortBy' and 'SortDirection' for ordering results.

request.description: User management request with pagination and filters

ShowMyOrgUnitOnly.description: Indicates if only users from the current organization unit should be shown

Ascending.description: Sort order: true for ascending, false for descending

Direction.description: Sort direction: true for ascending, false for descending

PageSize.description: Number of items per page for pagination

example_uses: Find all users in my organization unit.
List users with 'Admin' role on page 2.
Search for users named 'John Doe' and sort by name.
Show me the first 10 users in my organization unit.
Get users filtered by 'IT Department' and sorted by 'Last Name' in ascending order.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to retrieve a paginated list of users, with options for filtering, searching, and sorting based on various criteria like roles, organization units, or search terms.

endpoints.name: GetUser
example_uses: Get details for user ID 'abc-123'.
Retrieve the profile information for a specific user.
Show me the details of user 'john.doe@example.com'.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to fetch the complete details of a single user by their unique identifier.

endpoints.name: UpdateUserRoles

Roles.description: List of roles (strings) to assign to the user

example_uses: Assign 'Admin' and 'Editor' roles to user 'xyz-456'.
Remove all roles from user 'def-789'.
Update the roles for user '123' to be 'Viewer' and 'Reporter'.
Set user 'user1' roles to only 'Contributor'.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to modify the roles assigned to a specific user, replacing their current roles with a new set.

endpoints.name: GetAvailableRoles
endpoints.description: Get available roles that the current user can assign.
example_uses: List all roles I can assign to users.
What are the available user roles in the system?
Show me the roles I have permission to manage.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to retrieve a list of all roles that the current authenticated user has permission to assign to other users.

endpoints.name: GetCurrentUserOrgUnit
endpoints.description: Get current user's organization unit for filtering.
example_uses: What is my current organization unit?
Retrieve the organization unit associated with my user account.
Tell me which organizational unit I belong to.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to determine the organization unit of the currently authenticated user, typically for filtering or context within the application.

endpoints.name: GetOrgUnitSelfManagement
example_uses: Check if self-management is enabled for org unit 'HQ'.
Retrieve the self-management setting for organization unit 'EMEA'.
Is self-management active for the 'Sales' department?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to check whether self-management of user roles is enabled for a specific organization unit.

endpoints.name: UpdateOrgUnitSelfManagement

IsSelfManagementEnabled.description: Boolean indicating whether self-management should be enabled or disabled

example_uses: Enable self-management for org unit 'HQ'.
Disable self-management for organization unit 'APAC'.
Set self-management to true for the 'Marketing' department.
Turn off self-management for 'Operations' org unit.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to change the self-management setting for user roles within a specific organization unit, allowing or disallowing users within that unit to manage their own roles.

endpoints.name: AnalyzeUserRoleFile
endpoints.description: Analyzes a Google Sheets file for user role import data.

request.description: File analysis request with type and fileId

FileId.description: ID of the file to analyze

CurrentUserId.description: ID of the current user performing the analysis

IsUpdate.description: Indicates if the analysis is for an update operation

example_uses: Analyze a Google Sheet with ID '123xyz' for user role updates.
Process a file to preview user role changes before bulk upload.
Check the contents of file 'file_A' for user role assignments.
Perform a dry run analysis on a user role import file.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you have a file (e.g., Google Sheet) containing user role data and need to analyze its content for potential import or update operations, typically to validate data before a bulk upload.

endpoints.name: BulkUploadUserRoles
endpoints.description: Performs bulk import of user role assignments.

request.description: Bulk upload request with user role data

Records.description: List of user role records to upload

IsUpdate.description: Indicates if the bulk upload is an update operation

example_uses: Perform a bulk upload of new user role assignments.
Update multiple user roles from a prepared dataset.
Import a large list of user role changes.
Execute the bulk import of user roles from the analyzed file.
Upload new user roles in bulk, specifying it's an update operation.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to import or update a large number of user role assignments in a single operation, typically from a pre-processed dataset or after analyzing a file.

endpoints.name: ResolveUsers
endpoints.description: Resolves user IDs to user details.

UserIds.description: List of user IDs to resolve

example_uses: Resolve user IDs [1, 2, 3] to their full details.
Get user information for a list of user identifiers.
Find details for users with IDs 5, 8, and 12.
Retrieve the profiles for a given set of user IDs.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you have a list of user IDs and need to retrieve their corresponding user details, such as names or other profile information.

endpoints.name: ResolveRoles
endpoints.description: Resolves role IDs to role details.

RoleIds.description: List of role IDs to resolve

example_uses: Resolve role IDs [101, 102] to their full details.
Get role information for a list of role identifiers.
Find details for roles with IDs 20, 25, and 30.
Retrieve the descriptions for a given set of role IDs.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you have a list of role IDs and need to retrieve their corresponding role details, such as role names or descriptions.
